versions.changelog:
fb-repost 1.0.0 — initial release

- Supports reposting Facebook posts to a Facebook Page: scrape content, rewrite for page style, auto-generate images (Gemini), post via Graph API.
- Works when user supplies any Facebook link and requests reposting/rewriting.
- Requires Apify/Gemini/Facebook Page credentials (guidance and env var support included).
- Step-by-step workflow: scrape post → analyze/rewrite → generate image → preview → seek confirmation → post.
- Built-in error handling and user-friendly confirmation/checklist before publishing.
